baseline.production_revision_policy: Deploy the exact codex-bootstrap-v0.2.0 tag together with its full commit SHA from the signed-off release provenance. The audited_base_commit records the starting tree inspected while this bundle was authored; it is not the deployable bundle revision. Never deploy a moving branch as a reproducible baseline.

requirements.platform: Linux; NCSA Delta x86_64 is the primary audited host

codex_compatibility_contract.policy: The Dr. Claw bundle is pinned independently from Codex. A newer Codex version remains acceptable when it is at or above codex_cli_minimum and every required contract probe passes. Versions not listed in codex_cli_audited_versions produce a warning unless --require-audited-codex-version is requested.
codex_compatibility_contract.isolation: Contract probes use a generated secret-free HOME, CODEX_HOME, and empty working directory. They do not read target authentication, sessions, connector credentials, or research projects.

source_policy.policy: These optional community gitlinks are pinned by path and object ID but are never initialized or executed by the bootstrap. Every additional, moved, changed, or initialized gitlink is rejected.

library.catalog_policy: The router supplements stale catalog entries from live SKILL.md discovery; doctor warns on drift.
library.install_policy: Keep the full tree in the versioned checkout. Install only the router into the native user skill location.

optional_tooling.name: drclaw-cli
optional_tooling.note: Installs a revision/Python/architecture-specific private virtual environment from the exact SHA256-locked universal-wheel closure; atomic launchers and doctor receipts detect drift.

optional_tooling.name: Dr. Claw web application
optional_tooling.note: Uses the pinned, checksum-verified Node runtime and a loopback-only user service; it remains independent from the Codex skill router.

observed_plugins.authentication: interactive OAuth; never copy connector state

components.plugin_policy: Plugin IDs and audited versions are portable inventory only. Product marketplaces and OAuth are target-host state; --install-plugins works only after the approved marketplace is available and never copies cache or connector credentials.

current-delta.warning: Reproduces the audited high-trust model/permission settings and must be explicitly selected.

managed_files: $HOME/.agents/skills/ncsa-delta (only on verified Delta or explicit opt-in)
never_copy: absolute project trust entries from another host
Delta account, quota, queue, or job runtime state
manual_steps: Complete codex login --device-auth on the target host.
For NCSA Delta, complete Kerberos password and Duo interactively through a concrete Mac SSH alias.
Initialize an approved Codex plugin marketplace, optionally run install --install-plugins, and authorize each connector through its own OAuth flow.
Inject API keys, JWT secrets, and private Git credentials through the target secret store.
Run doctor and a read-only Codex smoke test after authentication.
